notes.1: This question was generally well done with many candidates scoring all 4 marks. Occasionally a negative sign was seen attached to the 0.3x term. Answer: v = 6 ms-1
notes.2i: The centres of mass of both the solid hemi-sphere and the hemi-spherical shell have to be found. Sometimes the incorrect formulae were used. These formulae are given in the formula booklet. To find the centre of mass of the sphere, moments had to be taken about the centre of the sphere. The common mistake was not to realise that one of the moments should be negative.
notes.2iii: To find the force, F, moments had to be taken about the point of contact. A common error was to use Fx0.2 instead of Fx0.4 for the moment of F about the point of contact. Answers: (i) Distance is 0.005 m (ii) F = 0.25
notes.3i: This part of the question was quite well done. The most common error was not to use the components of the tension. Sometimes the wrong extension was used.
notes.3iii: To solve this part of the question a four term energy equation was required. Too often only three terms appeared. Answers: (i) m = 0.2 kg (ii) v = 2.47 ms–1
notes.4: This question proved to be a very popular one with many candidates scoring all 7 marks.
notes.4i: A number of candidates used +3t instead of –3t. Also some candidates did not introduce a constant of integration.
notes.4iii: If the constant of integration was omitted then only method marks could be scored. No accuracy marks were available. Answers: (i) Initial speed is 54 ms–1 (ii) Distance travelled is 108 m �PAGE�43
notes.5i: This part of the question was generally well done and many candidates scored all 3 marks. Some candidates only found half the time and half the distance.
notes.5iii: Many candidates scored all 4 marks. Those candidates failing to score full marks usually used t = 4.7, the time for travelling from O to P and not the time for the first bounce. Answers: (i) Time to travel from O to P is 4.7 s and the distance OP is 40.2 m
notes.5ii: The speed when leaving P is 13.2 ms–1
notes.6i: Having found the required centres of mass the candidates then attempted to take moments about O. Sometimes the incorrect formula was used for the centre of mass of a semi-circular lamina and too often a sign error occurred in the moment equation.
notes.6iii: This part of the question was very well done. Answers: (i) Distance of centre of mass from O is 4(1 + r + r 2)/3π(1 + r) (cid:68)
notes.7i: This part of the question was generally well done.
notes.7iii: Many candidates scored well on this part of the question. T = 10 was found and Tsin60 = 0.5Rx6.25 2 leading to R = 0.4434… The last 3 marks were lost by quite a number of candidates. Answers: (i) Radius of path of P is 0.16 m and speed of P is 1 ms–1
notes.7ii: Total length of string is 0.832 m �PAGE�44

• Care needs to be taken to avoid arithmetic and sign errors.
• Candidates need to make full use of the supplied list of formulae.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates scored a range of marks on this paper. The easier questions were 1, 3, 4, 5(i), 6(iii) and 7(i).
The harder questions were 2(ii), 6(i) and 7(ii).
